title: Only Israel’s Arab Parties Can Restore Its Democracy
gist: Teaser-length piece: Shlomo Ben-Ami says Israel's recent election produced a deadlock rather than accountability for Netanyahu, and argues the opposition can only unseat him by forming a coalition with Arab-led parties.

insights.claim: Israel's recent election delivered a deadlock, with an electorate deeply split along tribal and cultural lines failing to hold Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu accountable for prolonged wars and Israel's damaged global standing.
insights.speaker: SHLOMO BEN-AMI
insights.so_what: Prolonged coalition uncertainty in Israel keeps regional political risk elevated.
insights.quote: Instead, the vote delivered a deadlock.
insights.locator: TEL AVIV—Before Israel’s election, I warned

insights.claim: Shlomo Ben-Ami says his pre-election warning not to pin high hopes on Israel's vote was vindicated by the outcome.
insights.speaker: SHLOMO BEN-AMI
insights.so_what: Low expectations for transformative change in Israeli policy remain warranted.
insights.locator: TEL AVIV—Before Israel’s election, I warned

insights.claim: Ben-Ami argues the Israeli opposition bloc could defeat Netanyahu and the ideology he embodies only by building a coalition with the Arab-led parties.
insights.speaker: SHLOMO BEN-AMI
insights.so_what: An opposition-Arab party coalition would be a historic shift; watch coalition negotiations as a signal for Israeli policy on wars and democracy.
insights.quote: By building a coalition with the Arab-led parties, the opposition bloc could defeat not only Benjamin Netanyahu but also the violent, racist ideology he embodies.
insights.locator: While Israel’s recent election did not deliver

insights.claim: Despite failing to deliver transformation, Ben-Ami contends the deadlocked Israeli election could open the way to restoring Israeli democracy.
insights.speaker: SHLOMO BEN-AMI
insights.so_what: A deadlock may be a window for change rather than pure stalemate.
insights.locator: While Israel’s recent election did not deliver
